g.text: Question Tree — Vibe: skill-fixed vs. LLM-recovered nodes; (OPEN) = handed to the team
Fixed node — prescribed by the Socratic Code-Theory Recovery skill (Q1-Q5, Q1.1-Q5.5)
Adaptive node — decomposed by the LLM from code evidence
Leaf the code cannot answer — handed to the team; every other leaf is answered from code with file:line evidence
